verdict.rationale: Office Click-to-Run's integrator.exe, running as SYSTEM under its own package root, spawns schtasks.exe to delete the OfficeBackgroundTaskHandlerLogon scheduled task, which is routine Office install/update maintenance. The cross-process access events (integrator.exe and csrss.exe opening schtasks.exe) are consistent with that normal parent-child activity and show no sign of credential access or injection.
